facts.text: Park Hyatt Busan is in Haeundae, Busan, with views of the ocean and Gwangan Bridge.
facts.excerpt: sprawling views of the ocean and the famed Gwangan Bridge, Park Hyatt Busan is situated in the heart of Haeundae

facts.text: The hotel's address is 51, Marine City 1-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan.
facts.excerpt: 51, Marine City 1-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan 48120, South Korea

facts.text: The hotel sits alongside shopping malls and the Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO).
facts.excerpt: alongside world-class shopping malls and Busan Exhibition and Convention Center (BEXCO)

facts.text: Guestrooms are decorated with beige-toned wood and have floor-to-ceiling windows with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: On stepping into a guestroom decorated with beige-toned wood, visitors can appreciate the inspiring view of the ocean through floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Bathrooms have rain showers and bathtubs with custom Le Labo products.
facts.excerpt: Spacious bathrooms with rain showers and bathtubs with custom Le Labo products

facts.text: In the Marina Ocean Corner Suites, the king bed sits at the corner of the floor-to-ceiling windows, with sunsets behind Gwangan Bridge.
facts.excerpt: The king size bed is located directly at the corner of our signature floor to ceiling windows where nightly sunsets are the backdrop of Busan

facts.text: Family Ocean Suites are designed specifically for families.
facts.excerpt: Designed specifically for families, our Family Ocean Suites are located on floors 6 to 16.

facts.text: Dining Room is the hotel's steak and seafood grill on the 32nd floor, with open kitchens and an open charcoal grill.
facts.excerpt: The open kitchens allow guests to watch the professional chefs cook a variety of meats and seafood over the open charcoal grill

facts.text: Dining Room also prepares Korean cuisine reinterpreted in Park Hyatt style.
facts.excerpt: prepare Korean cuisine reinterpreted in Park Hyatt style

facts.text: Living Room is an Italian restaurant on the 31st floor serving traditional Italian comfort food.
facts.excerpt: Living Room, an Italian restaurant located on the 31st floor, is a sophisticated residential-style outlet.

facts.text: Living Room Bar is on the 31st floor with a view of Gwangan Bridge.
facts.excerpt: Living Room Bar is located on the 31st floor. Guests can enjoy the breathtaking view of Gwangan Bridge

facts.text: Living Room Bar holds a Champagne & Jazz Night on the last Friday of each month.
facts.excerpt: held on the last Friday of each month

facts.text: Lounge is on the 30th floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 30th floor of Park Hyatt Busan, Lounge greets its guests

facts.text: Patisserie, the hotel's pastry boutique at the entrance, serves homemade European pastries, chocolates and pralines.
facts.excerpt: serving homemade European pastries, chocolates and pralines

facts.text: Ocelas Spa has treatment rooms designed for couples.
facts.excerpt: Ocelas Spa offers seven treatment rooms, including two designed for couples

facts.text: The hotel has a granite indoor swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: granite indoor swimming pool offers guests the chance to experience true relaxation

facts.text: The pool and sauna area has views of Gwangan Bridge at night.
facts.excerpt: Our pool and sauna area is particularly gorgeous at night, with ambient lighting and stunning views of Gwangan Bridge.

facts.text: The fitness center has a private studio for personal training.
facts.excerpt: a private studio for personal training

facts.text: Gimhae International Airport (PUS) is 25 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Gimhae International Airport (PUS)25 kilometers

facts.text: Self-parking is free for registered guests, one car per room.
facts.excerpt:
Registered Guests (for 1 car per room)

Free

facts.text: Hotel limousines to and from the airport must be reserved in advance.
facts.excerpt: Private limousines are available to and from the hotel and airport and must be reserved in advance.

facts.text: For sustainability, certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request.
facts.excerpt: certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request
